description: Empties the document-level fetchedAt so PeopleFreshness takes two 'return null' arms at once -- the Number.isNaN guard inside the shared formatDate (src/components/shared/formatDate.js line 12) and the !fetchedAt guard that drops the paragraph (src/components/PeopleFreshness/index.js line 13). fetchedAt is one field on the one file the community pages read, so emptying it in the ordinary coverage build would swap which arm renders rather than add a case; it belongs to the variant build, which is served beside the real one. The value is "" and not null because formatDate runs `new Date(isoDate)`: new Date(null) coerces to 0 and formats as December 31, 1969, which would keep the paragraph rendering with an absurd date instead of reaching the guards this overlay exists for.
